Key.English: Enables the path planning mode: drag a path in front of a selected unit or vehicle and it drives, flies, sails or walks it. Off by default.
Trail the Rest of the Selection

While tracing one path, give every other selected unit of the same kind the same path ending a fixed distance further back, so a column is one gesture instead of six. Only paths nothing has been drawn on are recruited, and grabbing a handle takes that path back under manual control.

Stop the selected units in place for as long as a path is being drawn for them, so they do not walk out from under it. Released when planning ends. Note that a unit already being held still by something else — a LAMBS garrison, for example — is released along with the rest.

Fastest a vehicle will drive a planned path, in km/h. Capped well below most vehicles' top speed on purpose: a vehicle given its full config speed drives a traced path like a time trial and loses the line on the first corner. A group set to Limited speed halves this again.
Nothing in the selection can be given a path

Time in minutes a unit may spend following a planned path before the path is abandoned. A backstop, not the usual way a path ends — it exists so a unit whose destination became unreachable is not still walking towards it hours later.

Opens path planning for the selected units and vehicles: drag the arrow in front of one to trace the path it should take. Press again to execute every path drawn, or Escape to cancel. Selecting a crew member plans for the vehicle he is riding in.
